case may be, in the same term of General Elections.
(5) Notwithstanding anything contained in this section,
if in a district, for any term of election, the number
of offices of the Sahakari Sabhadhipati, available
for reservation after exclusion of the Zilla Parishads
or the Siliguri Mahakuma Parishad, as the case may
be, where offices of the Sabhadhipati have been
reserved for that term of election, is less than the
number of offices determined under sub-section (1)
or sub-section (2) or sub-section (3), such number
of offices of the Sahakari Sabhadhipati as are
available shall be reserved for that term of election,
and the number of offices determined under sub-
section (1) or sub-section (2) or sub-section (3),
as the case may be, shall be deemed to be re-
determined accordingly.
Explanation. - A member of the Scheduled Castes
or the Scheduled Tribes or the Backward Classes or
Women shall not be disqualified to hold an office
of the Sabhadhipati or Sahakari Sabhadhipati not
reserved for the Scheduled Castes, Scheduled
Tribes, Backward Classes or Women, as the case
may be, if such member is otherwise qualified to
hold such office under this Act.]
